en:
Hm!
Haaaaaaaaaaah!\pAaaah! This is heavenly!
The water warms me to my core!\pYou should jump in, too.\pGo to the middle, relax, and get
good and warm!
My favorite part of bathing comes\nup right after this.\pI enjoy a bowl of chowder to\nwarm me from the inside, too!
The water is perfectly warm.\nIt feels exquisite…\p{PLAYER} and the POKéMON were\nfully refreshed!
Soaking in a hot spring pool is\ntherapeutic, people say.
Have a look at my face.\nSee how smooth my skin is?\pThe hot spring's water keeps my\nskin younger than my age.

After an honest day of training,
nothing beats a relaxing soak in\lthe hot spring pool.\pBRUNO, who's a senior ahead of me,
visits the SPA on occasion.\pHe comes to rehab injuries, both
his own and his POKéMON's.

Hot springs go hand-in-hand with
volcanoes.\pThe EMBER SPA here, well,
I made it years ago.\pI hewed the pool right out of a
gigantic boulder by hand.\pI was using this at the time.
I suppose I can part with it.
That shatters boulders as if they\nwere made of crackers.
